versions.subject: feat: add new rules related to linux reverse shells (#4166)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '/perl'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -e '
selection_content:
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'fdopen('
        - '::Socket::INET'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Socket'
        - 'connect'
        - 'open'
        - 'exec'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*/perl" CommandLine="* -e *" (CommandLine="*fdopen(*" CommandLine="*::Socket::INET*") OR (CommandLine="*Socket*" CommandLine="*connect*" CommandLine="*open*" CommandLine="*exec*")
